question: In the Li3PO4-coated NCM study, how much did the charge-transfer resistance rise over 50 cycles for the bare and the coated material, and what capacity did each retain after 100 cycles at 1C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%Li3PO4%' OR text ILIKE '%Li3 PO4%' OR text ILIKE '%charge transfer%' OR text ILIKE '%charge-transfer%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, table_id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%PO4%' OR text ILIKE '%phosph%' OR text ILIKE '%NCM%' ORDER BY table_id, row_no, col_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page = 8 ORDER BY line_no

WITH a AS (SELECT text t FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L38'), b AS (SELECT text t FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L40') SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(b.t,'from ([0-9.]+) to',1) AS DOUBLE) AS lpo_before, CAST(regexp_extract(b.t,'to ([0-9.]+) Ω',1) AS DOUBLE) AS lpo_after, CAST(regexp_extract(a.t,'from ([0-9.]+) to',1) AS DOUBLE) AS bare_before, CAST(regexp_extract(a.t,'to ([0-9.]+) Ω',1) AS DOUBLE) AS bare_after FROM a, b

WITH a AS (SELECT text t FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L38'), b AS (SELECT text t FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L40') SELECT (CAST(regexp_extract(a.t,'to ([0-9.]+) Ω',1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(a.t,'from ([0-9.]+) to',1) AS DOUBLE)) AS bare_rise, (CAST(regexp_extract(b.t,'to ([0-9.]+) Ω',1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(b.t,'from ([0-9.]+) to',1) AS DOUBLE)) AS lpo_rise FROM a, b
